title: Battery
lead: Estimated usable capacity, how it changes over time, and how the battery is used.

stats.lowestHint: at the end of a trip

honest.title: Read this as an estimate.
honest.body: The figures come from the car's own energy and charge-level readings, not from a battery test. The absolute level can be off by a few percent: the displayed charge level hides a buffer and is rounded to whole percent. A value above 100 % of the nominal capacity is possible for that reason and does not mean the battery grew. The trend over several months says more than the level.

capacity.title: Usable capacity
capacity.note: Per trip, energy used divided by the charge points lost gives an implied capacity. Only trips that lost at least {{trip}} points count, and a month is only shown once its trips add up to {{month}} points. Months are energy-weighted totals, not averages of single trips.
capacity.tooLittle: No month has enough long trips yet (at least {{trip}} charge points per trip and {{month}} points per month). Import more history or drive a few longer trips.
capacity.perTrip: Single trips with at least {{points}} points used
capacity.perTripNone: No trip used {{points}} charge points or more.
capacity.trendNote: Weighted trend over {{months}} months: {{slope}} kWh per year (standard error {{se}}). A slope smaller than about twice its error cannot be told apart from noise.

usage.title: How the battery is used
usage.note: Based on the trips of the selected period. Charge levels are taken at the start and at the end of each trip.
usage.histogram: Charge level at trip start and end (%)
usage.lowest: Lowest level at a trip end

care.title: Battery care
care.note: Neutral observations from your data. Lithium-ion cells tend to age a little faster when they stay at a very high or very low charge level for long periods; check your manual for the charge limit the manufacturer suggests for daily use.
care.noSoc: The trips in this period carry no charge level, so there is nothing to evaluate.
care.highFew: {{share}} of the trips started at 90 % or more, so the battery rarely left the house that full.
care.highMany: {{share}} of the trips started at 90 % or more. If you do not need the range every day, a lower daily charge limit would reduce time spent at a high charge level.
care.lowFew: {{share}} of the trips ended at 20 % or less; the lowest level reached was {{min}} %.
care.lowMany: {{share}} of the trips ended at 20 % or less; the lowest level reached was {{min}} %. Charging a little earlier would keep the battery out of the low range more often.
care.chargeHigh: {{share}} of the {{count}} detected charges (at least {{gain}} points) ended at 90 % or more.
care.chargeLow: Only {{share}} of the {{count}} detected charges (at least {{gain}} points) ended at 90 % or more.
